evidenceActuallyInspected.media: ffprobe comparison.mp4: 65.2 s, 30/1 fps, single H.264 video stream, no audio stream. Decoded-phone-night.png is a selected actual film frame. The full-reel export metadata lists 2655 frames at 30 fps; full continuous film was not watched.
evidenceActuallyInspected.reportedChecks: 23 passing tests; 108 browser cases; 567 geometry samples with no mismatches/invalid. These records were read, not independently rerun, and are not creative or hardware proof.

strengths.finding: The previous phone visual-cause mismatch has a concrete source and rendered correction.
strengths.basis: The 390 before/current images at 790 ms show the lateral head roll becoming a more upward, centered investigation beneath the heading. At 330 ms attention is already upward; current 1190/1900 samples retain upward reading instead of the former downward scan. 320 and 1440 evidence show the adaptation is composition-aware rather than a theme change. staging.js derives direction from actual host/heading rectangles.

strengths.finding: The offer has clearer silent punctuation without added anatomy or an extra flourish.
strengths.basis: Matched day/night hands sheets show a small upward cup separated from the ruff. Current motion moves the hand to 407,458,-26 degrees, versus 393,447,+25 before. Offer sequences show the tucked 2350 ms hand moving outward/up by 2720 ms and holding through 4100 ms; the free hand stays quiet.

strengths.finding: Return and invitation remain separate authored beats.
strengths.basis: staging.js releases all gaze/head correction by 2350 ms, before the offer reaches its endpoint. Actual 2350/2720 day/night phone samples show the visitor-facing return and then the clearer cup. No audio accent is needed to distinguish those sampled poses.

strengths.finding: Hand cleanup gives supporting gestures less competing contour noise.
strengths.basis: Thinking keeps its original high chin contact while lowering the free hand; grateful has a lower joined pair below the ruff; focused has separated low hands; worried retains a diagonal upper/lower relation. The matched sheets and size ladders show these improvements most clearly at 160/240 CSS px.

strengths.finding: Silence and attention restraint survive the new staging system.
strengths.basis: No authored audio API was found and comparison.mp4 has no audio stream. The new mapper adds no autonomous timer or animation loop. The existing finite engine, pause/seek, still startup, reduced-motion presentation and hidden/offscreen pause remain; the controller advances staging only with active clip time and caches layout outside frame rendering.

strengths.finding: The reference character remains small and soft across the new gestures.
strengths.basis: Unchanged character.js SHA, actual same-size matched sheets, preserved tiny mitten paths, short wrist reach, feet and four wings; current browser evidence records equal numeric poses across themes.

The head/eye adjustment is visibly more coherent with the heading, but it is not as immediately explicit a cue as the later glasses and hand change.
deductions.continuity: The old wrong-axis defect is closed; this is a smaller signal-strength judgment. Normal-speed or unfamiliar-observer failure has not been established, so do not inflate it into a blocker or fix it with a sound cue.

improvementCriteria: Keep 160/240 CSS px or the current phone scene as the practical setting for gesture-rich storytelling; treat 96/128 px gestures as accents unless neutral observation shows more specificity.

Review normal-speed silent 1900–2720 ms playback at intended scene size, checking whether the wrist turn reads as one offer rather than a flick. Frame order establishes a bounded transition, not perceived rhythm.

If the subtle upward cue warrants more work, compare a small reversible head/gaze timing change in the actual composition while keeping anatomy, scene copy and quiet supporting hand constant. Retain the current version unless the rendered comparison establishes a clearer cause.
Use neutral, unfamiliar-observer prompts before claiming the question is noticed or shared. Preserve owner preference and specialist judgment separately.
Only if optional sound is commissioned later, define a separate reversible opt-in and test sparse cues against this already functional silent baseline. No audio is required for current acceptance.
